description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling keyboard button interactions in a web-based remote control interface, including processing button presses, toggle buttons, and enabling specific keyboard rewrite buttons.

methods.name: processButton
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for a button to send keydown and keyup events via the dc object.

methods.name: processToggleButton
methods.description: Sets up a toggle button that alternates between sending keydown and keyup events and toggles its active class.

methods.name: enableKeyboardRewriteButton
methods.description: Initializes toggle buttons for shift, ctrl, alt, super, and a regular button for tab, configuring their event handlers.
